title: Intermittent EDHOC test failures need macOS canonical-build verification (wtxl family 3)
description: Child of wtxl family (3): intermittent failures across runs of test_edhoc_transport.py::test_derived_contexts_have_matching_keys and test_edhoc_responder.py::test_publication_failure_cleans_session_without_publishing. wtxl instructs verifying against the macOS canonical build before touching any vectors - a Linux/heft worker cannot distinguish environment flakiness (timing, async scheduling, filesystem) from a real cross-platform divergence, and the EDHOC vectors are cross-implementation oracles that must not be regenerated to chase a flake. Work for the claimer (or Mark on the Mac): run both tests repeatedly (e.g. 50x) on the macOS canonical checkout and on heft; if both pass repeatedly, record as environment flake and close; if the Mac reproduces, capture the failing state, diff against the oscore/edhoc crate behavior, and fix code (not vectors). Do NOT regenerate edhoc vector files as part of this.
